bio: Thanks to its quality produce prepared with precision, this sleek, understatedly stylish Japanese-inspired restaurant has made a real impact in Krakow. It's a professionally run place, offering colourful dishes that are fragrant and full of flavour. The lunch menu revolves largely around set bento box options that include sushi, salad and gyoza, while Korean cuisine is also represented on the main menu with dishes such as kimchi jjigae....
